comments.author: @privateprivate8366
comments.text:
I think the reality is that educational institutions and lenders are predatory. My parents were educators and didn’t see it that way. Even if they weren’t, they became as predatory as any other institution now is. Their primary concern has always been to keep their doors open. Not ensure you had a landing and career, once you graduated, even if they offered resources. And the typical disconnect now is, “If you can’t find a job or the job of your dreams, that’s on you,” even though they probably knew that, when you were a freshman.

In addition, while it’s nice to help people, I think that’s because most people feel that they want to be a good person, they want to be seen as a good person, and the people they help will be nice to them, in return. Not always…
